key_insight: Hybrid-DFT calculations identify Mn-substituted MOF-5 as a promising bifunctional oxygen electrocatalyst, linking dopant electronic structure to ORR/OER activity.
engineering_relevance: Replacing selected Zn sites with transition metals offers a computationally guided route to MOF-based catalysts with reduced reliance on precious metals.
method: Model Sc–Cu substitutions at Zn sites in MOF-5 using hybrid DFT.
Assess stability, electronic structure, and interactions with oxygenated intermediates.
Estimate ORR/OER overpotentials using the computational hydrogen electrode model.
evidence_signal: Calculated ORR overpotentials are 0.57 V for Mn and Fe substitutions; OER overpotentials are 0.42 V for Mn and 0.51 V for Co substitutions.
watch_item: These computational predictions require experimental validation of dopant incorporation, catalytic activity, and framework durability under operating conditions.
paper_title: Transition-Metal Substitutions in MOF-5: A Hybrid-DFT Study of Oxygen Electrocatalysis
